Secondary Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) - In-Service Teachers (Secondary Level)

howToApply: Visit the MP Online portal at www.mponline.gov.in or the MPESB website at www.esb.mp.gov.in.
Go to Citizen Services > Application > ESB link to access the online application form.
Read all instructions and examination rules carefully before proceeding.

Fill in all required details accurately including personal information, educational qualifications, appointment order number, date, DISE Code of current posting, and Unique ID/IFMIS Code (for government school teachers).

Upload scanned color photograph, signature, and two lines of handwritten text (self-declaration) as per specified format (JPG format, white background, front-facing photo with both ears visible, not older than 3 months).
Upload mandatory documents: 8th/10th/12th marksheet (for date of birth proof), caste/category certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), original appointment order.

Write and upload the self-declaration in own handwriting: ‘I declare that all information provided in the application is completely true. If any information is found false or unsatisfactory at any stage, my examination/result may be cancelled.’
Pay the examination fee online via Credit/Debit Card, Internet Banking, or through authorized MP Online Kiosk.
After successful payment, note down the application form number and keep the computerized receipt safely.
Modifications in the application form can be made between 21-08-2026 and 09-09-2026 by paying the modification fee.
Download the Admit Card from www.esb.mp.gov.in using the application form number.
For assistance, contact MP Online Helpdesk at 0755-6720200 or MPESB Toll-Free: 18002337899 or email: complaint.esb@mp.gov.in.
